_about.purpose: What each unit's ART ACTUALLY DEPICTS, dictated by the operator 2026-09-06. Ground truth: it exists so the name/art question is answered ONCE and never re-derived by eye or by model.

verdicts.proxy: Art does not depict the unit but was DELIBERATELY chosen as the closest available. Not a defect; replacing it is an art decision, not a bug fix.
verdicts.wrong: Art does not depict the unit and was not a deliberate choice. A misassignment to correct.
verdicts.damaged: Subject is right but the pixels are broken -- detached fragments, holes, or shared with another unit.
verdicts.crafted: Hand-made art by the operator, installed into the mod. Supersedes both the old art and anything generated. Not a candidate -- it is done.
verdicts.keep: Existing art is the final choice. Not crafted by the operator and not a defect -- generation was TRIED and lost. No candidate is offered.
